recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38048 unless a future OO decision reopens the broader Device conformsTo wording.
issue_request: FHIR-38048 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for OO. It asked to fix Device.specialization.systemType because the R5 ballot text reused Device.property wording; the accepted resolution was to describe the code as identifying the specific standard that the device adheres to.
initial_application: Commit 0d858aae58 first replaced the copied Device.property wording with specialization-specific text, and commit 5e493f88ee refined Device.specialization.systemType to the Jira comment wording: a code of the system that identifies the standard that the device adheres to, with a definition about the specific standard. Commit 2cfdd9c837 later broadened the renamed Device.conformsTo.specification definition.
additional_context: OO 2022-09-12 minutes record the persuasive-with-modification vote and note the wording should be synchronized with the R5 ballot. Later Published issues FHIR-39084 and FHIR-39242 renamed Device.specialization to Device.conformsTo and systemType to specification, and the combined branch already includes FHIR-39084/FHIR-39242/FHIR-38109 reconciliation commits.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Device is active in source/fhir.ini, the legacy Device.specialization.systemType path maps to Device.conformsTo.specification, and source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml defines that element as identifying the specific standard, specification, protocol, formal guidance, regulation, legislation, or certification scheme to which the device adheres.
